findings.title: Export uses draft search while visible registry retains applied query
findings.counterexample: Successful visible list for query A; type query B without submitting the search form; trigger Export then Download. listUsers is not called, while exportRequest sends B.
findings.expected: Same applied current registry scope/filter/order, without pagination.
findings.correction: Separate draft input from applied/current successfully loaded query, or apply/await it before export; request and export scope must derive from one admitted list snapshot.
findings.testOracle: Use actual AdminUsersScreen input/export handlers. Show unsubmitted draft cannot export a different unseen slice, then assert applied list/export criteria match.

findings.title: Combined staleness stimulus masks grant regression; required frontend sensitivity evidence absent
findings.counterexample: Changing both scope search and disabled keeps the test green if the disabled invalidation/guard rule regresses, since the search change still invalidates revision. Blob type+size accepts altered same-length bytes. No relevant actual frontend authority/enum red-green sensitivity receipt was found.
findings.correction: Independently test scope change and grant-only revocation; compare handed-off Blob contents; author performs a bounded meaningful client authority/unknown-state sensitivity check, restores final source and records green.
findings.testOracle: Grant-only change with all other props stable stops completion/handoff; unknown state is denied before capability; exact completed stream bytes are handed off. Actual selected bad rule must produce a behavioral assertion FAIL rather than import/infra failure.

findings.title: PWA trend download success directs user to Telegram
findings.counterexample: PWA headman trend export uses newly wired browser port; accepted result still renders Telegram-specific success text.
findings.correction: Use reportDownloadAcceptedMessage for the trend as for other exports.
findings.testOracle: Verify the carrier-specific handoff feedback on the affected real PWA path; no unit wording test required.
